{{Quote|When it's not boring, you know that you've failed.''"<br />"''You're obviously unused to failure.''"<br />"''You have that right.|Raslan and [[Shalla Nelprin]] regarding a mission|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Raslan''' was an ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer who had declared allegiance with [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. He was the commander of the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] that transported an intrusion team to the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Razor's Kiss]]'' still under construction at the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] as well as leading the mission to seize the vessel. He was a successful, logical officer, and was unused to failure.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />

He complained that [[Shalla Nelprin|"Qatya"]] made too much noise during her first encounter with a member of the Kuati security aboard the Star Dreadnaught, but was subsequently impressed with her performance as she silently eliminated or incapacitated the rest of their opposition. Raslan would later be killed during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet's attacks on the ''Razor's Kiss''.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />
